observations: Photo 0 shows a black Canon DSLR camera with a lens attached, held in hand. The lens is labeled 'CANON ZOOM LENS EF-S 18-55mm 1:3.5-5.6 STM'. The camera body has 'Canon' and 'EOS Rebel T6i' visible on the top right.
Photo 1 shows the top of the camera with the shutter count dial, mode dial, and control buttons. The lens barrel has '55' visible, likely indicating 55mm focal length.
Photo 2 shows the back of the camera with the LCD screen, viewfinder, and control buttons. The lens is still attached, and the camera appears to be in hand.
All photos show a watermark 'MCSTEVE POSTED ON JIJI'.
No visible damage to the camera body or lens in the photos, but no close-up of the sensor, mirror, or internal components is shown.

claims.claim: Very Neat and Clean USA Used Canon EOS T6i/750D DSLR Camera still looking like a new one
claims.evidence: Photos show no visible damage, but no close-up of sensor, mirror, or internal components. The 'USA Used' claim cannot be verified remotely.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or function properly
risks.proof: Video or photo showing the camera turning on, menu navigation, and taking a photo.

risks.risk: Sensor may be dirty, scratched, or damaged
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the camera sensor with lens removed.

risks.risk: Lens may have fungus, scratches, or internal damage
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lens glass and barrel, especially at the front and rear elements.

risks.risk: Camera may have internal mechanical issues (e.g., shutter, mirror, focus) not visible in photos
risks.proof: Video showing the camera in operation, including shutter count, mirror movement, and autofocus.

proof_requests: Video or photo showing the camera turning on and taking a photo.
Close-up photo of the camera sensor with lens removed.
Close-up photo of the lens glass and barrel.
Video showing the camera in operation, including shutter count, mirror movement, and autofocus.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
